summary: Tested two bug fixes: (1) Onboarding wizard simplified to single step with Add/Sync Property options (Manual and OTA via iCal) - VERIFIED WORKING. (2) DELETE /api/properties/{id} now cascades to remove property_id from staff's assigned_properties using MongoDB $pull - VERIFIED WORKING. Team page will no longer show orphaned property IDs after property deletion.

onboarding_wizard_single_step.details: Wizard has only ONE step titled 'Add / Sync Property' with two options: Add Manually and Sync from OTA (iCal)

onboarding_manual_property_add.details: Manual option shows Property Name input only, creates property via POST /api/properties

onboarding_ota_sync.details: OTA option shows Property Name + iCal URL inputs, creates property via POST /api/ota/import-property

onboarding_multiple_properties.details: After adding a property, 'Add Another' button appears allowing multiple properties before Get Started

onboarding_get_started_button.details: Get Started button disabled until at least 1 property added, then enables

delete_property_cascade.details: DELETE /api/properties/{id} uses MongoDB $pull to remove property_id from ALL staff's assigned_properties arrays

no_orphaned_ids_on_team_page.details: After property deletion, staff's assigned_properties no longer contains deleted property_id, so Team page won't show raw IDs

(2) Property deletion cascades to staff.assigned_properties using $pull - prevents orphaned IDs on Team page. All 7 backend pytest tests pass.
